subject: Stash-visibility divergences (E4.0 fuzzer): import-into-caller glob-install invisible cross-file; bare `*alias = \&sub` alias not callable as bareword
description: Two related known divergences the E4.0 fuzzer pins (both pipelines, pre-existing): (1) a module's import() doing *{caller()."::gift"} = sub{} installs a sub the caller's transpiled code cannot see (defined &gift false, bareword call unresolved) — caller() returns the right package but the glob write and the caller's compiled references don't meet; fuzzer snippet 'module import-into-caller' (perl=G8, pcl=missing). (2) BEGIN { *ali = \&real } then bare `ali . "!"` — perl resolves via live stash (calls), PCL strings it; no prototype to premerge (fuzzer 'pragma */alias-bare', perl=R8!, pcl=ali8!). Both are the runtime-stash-vs-transpile-time-knowledge class; the general fix direction is stash-aware bareword resolution or extending the premerge family to `*name = \&other` aliases of in-file subs. Rare in real code (Moo chain unaffected after #80); fuzzer clusters keep them visible.
